new.name: Craven's Timmy
new.description: A simple emerger with a moose hair tail, a hare's mask body and a wing, casing and legs all made from macrame yarn.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it in the film during mayfly and midge hatches.
mats: Black, smoke grey and brown macrame yarn
steps: Tie in a few moose hairs as a tail.
Dub a slim hare's mask body.
Tie in the yarn on top, fold it forward for the casing and split the ends for legs.
Leave a short tuft as the wing and finish.

new.name: Antonio's Mayfly Adult
new.description: An all-CDC mayfly with a Coq de Leon tail, a ribbed CDC body, a fire orange hot spot and a CDC wing.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it to risers during mayfly hatches; dry it with a powder floatant.
mats: Coq de Leon or rooster saddle
Flat tinsel or extra-small copper wire
steps: Tie in a split tail and the rib.
Twist CDC and wrap a slim body, then rib it.
Tie in a small hot spot and a CDC wing.
Wrap a CDC thorax around the wing and finish.

new.name: AP Emerger
new.description: An emerger in the style of the AP nymph, with a flank fibre tail, a brown body, a peacock thorax and a partridge hackle.
new.fishing_tips: Swing it or let it rise at the end of the drift.
steps: Tie in the tail and rib.
Dub a slim body and rib it.
Wrap a peacock herl thorax.
Wind one or two turns of partridge.

new.name: McPhail BWO Emerger
new.description: A blue-winged olive emerger with a barred wood duck tail, an olive biot body, an olive hare's thorax and a CDC wing bubble.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it in the film to fish refusing duns.
mats: Natural CDC, looped as a bubble
steps: Tie in a short wood duck tail.
Wrap a smooth biot body.
Tie in CDC as a loop over the thorax.
Dub the thorax and finish.

new.name: Barr's Vis-A-Dun
new.description: John Barr's buoyant, easy-to-see mayfly with a dun tail, a superfine body, a grey yarn wing and a dun hackle.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it in riffles and choppy water during hatches.
mats: Dun spade hackle or Coq de Leon
steps: Tie in the tail.
Dub a slim body.
Tie in a short yarn wing angled forward.
Wind the hackle and trim it flat underneath.

new.name: Barry's Carp
new.description: A crayfish-like carp fly with small brass eyes, a rabbit tail, a mono-ribbed FINO skin casing over a goat dubbing body and soft hackle legs.
new.fishing_tips: Drop it in front of feeding carp and twitch once.
mats: Small or medium black brass eyes
Rust or orange angora goat dubbing
steps: Add lead and the brass eyes.
Tie in a rabbit tail, the rib and the FINO skin.
Dub the body and wind a soft hackle through it.
Pull the casing over and rib it.

new.name: Batwing Emerger
new.description: A PMD emerger with a glass midge bead, a wood duck tail, a biot body and a pheasant rump wing that sticks out like bat wings.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it just under the film during PMD hatches.
steps: Slide on the glass bead and tie in the tail.
Wrap a biot body.
Tie in the rump feather and split it into wings.
Dub the thorax behind the bead.

new.name: Biot Midge Emerger
new.description: A tiny midge emerger with a goose biot body, a black thorax and an India hen collar.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it in the film on flat winter water.
steps: Tie in the biot and wrap a segmented body.
Dub a small black thorax.
Wind one turn of India hen.
Whip finish.

new.name: Duck Fly
new.description: An adult black midge (the Irish duck fly) with a white tag, a pheasant tail body, a red and black thorax and hackle-tip wings.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it on Irish loughs in early spring.
mats: Red floss and black seal's fur with Lite-Brite
Indian grizzle or cree hackle tips
steps: Leave a white tag and tie in the rib.
Wrap the pheasant tail body and rib it.
Tie in the wing tips and the tinsel cover.
Dub the thorax and pull the cover over.

new.name: Blue Ice Jig
new.description: A quick jig nymph with a marabou tail, a wire body and an Ice Dub thorax, tied in any colour.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it on a tight line or under an indicator.
steps: Slide on the bead and tie in a short marabou tail.
Wrap a smooth wire body.
Dub an Ice Dub thorax.
Finish behind the bead.

new.name: Bonecrusher
new.description: A bonefish fly with bead chain eyes, a red D-Rib body, a sand craft fur wing, a pearl cactus chenille head and Crazy Legs.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it in skinny water with short, quick strips.
mats: Tan or sand pseudo fibre or craft fur
steps: Tie on the bead chain eyes.
Wrap a D-Rib body.
Tie in a wing with legs on each side.
Wrap cactus chenille around the eyes.

new.name: Bonefish Junk
new.description: A detailed bonefish shrimp with superfloss antennae, shredded braid flash, egg yarn mouthparts, mono eyes and a Diamond Braid body.
new.fishing_tips: Strip it slowly and stop when the fish tips down.
steps: Tie on the bead chain eyes.
Tie in antennae, flash, mouthparts and mono eyes at the bend.
Wrap a braid body with legs.
Finish at the eye.

new.name: Craven's Gov't Cheese
new.description: A foam-backed caddis or attractor with a ribbed superfine abdomen, a yarn and deer hair wing, a foam back and a pink indicator.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it in riffles where you need to see the fly.
steps: Dub and rib the abdomen.
Tie in the yarn and deer hair wing.
Tie the foam down over the thorax and add the indicator.
Dub the thorax and finish.

new.name: Deer Hair Beetle
new.description: A classic beetle with a black deer hair shell pulled over a sparkle dubbing underbody, with the hair tips left as legs.
new.fishing_tips: Drift it along banks in summer.
steps: Tie in a bunch of deer hair by the tips at the bend.
Dub a sparkle underbody.
Pull the hair forward and tie it down to form a shell.
Leave some tips as legs and trim the rest.

new.name: Dirty Hippy
new.description: A copper cone streamer with fox fur belly, a tan marabou wing, an arctic fox collar, a UV Ice Dub face and holographic eyes.
new.fishing_tips: Strip and swing it for trout and smallmouth.
mats: Cream temple dog or arctic fox
steps: Add the cone and lead.
Tie in flash and a fox belly.
Tie a marabou wing and a fox collar.
Dub the face and glue on eyes.

new.name: Doobry
new.description: A Scottish loch fly with a red wool tail, a gold tinsel body, palmered black hackle and hot orange then black front hackles.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it as a bob fly in a big wave.
mats: Hot orange hen, then long black hen
steps: Tie in the tail and rib.
Wind the tinsel body and palmer the black hackle.
Rib it.
Wind the orange then black front hackles.

new.name: EP Tarpon Streamer
new.description: A black and purple tarpon fly made from EP fibres with Sparkle Dub Brush flash and big eyes.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it in dark water and at dusk.
mats: Fish Skull Living Eyes or EP eyes
steps: Tie in a purple EP tail with flash.
Tie black EP fibres in bunches forward.
Trim to a tapered shape.
Glue on eyes.

new.name: Flip Flop
new.description: A bonefish shrimp with bead chain weight, mono and resin eyes, a tan craft fur tail and body, flash and pink superfloss legs.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it in skinny water.
mats: Tan craft fur in a loop
steps: Tie on the bead chain.
Tie in the tail, flash and eyes.
Spin a craft fur body in a loop and add legs.
Brush it out and finish.

new.name: Foam Black Ant
new.description: A floating ant with a black foam body, Glister, white hackle-point wings and black deer hair legs.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it during ant falls in summer.
mats: Black closed-cell foam, 2 mm by 4 mm, and black Glister
steps: Tie the foam down to form the rear segment.
Tie in hackle-point wings flat.
Tie in deer hair legs.
Bring the foam forward for the front segment.

new.name: Foamulator
new.description: A foam-backed Stimulator with a deer hair tail, an Ice Dub body, palmered hackle, a web wing underwing and deer hair overwing.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it as a stonefly or hopper in summer.
mats: Golden brown deer hair and white McFlylon
steps: Tie in the tail and foam.
Dub the rear body and palmer the hackle.
Pull the foam over and add the wings.
Finish the thorax.

new.name: Galloup's Found Link
new.description: Galloup's spinner-and-dun with an elk body, spent yarn wings and an upright elk wing.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it during mixed hatches.
steps: Dub a thin superfine underbody and tie in a Coq de Leon tail.
Tie down a bunch of yearling elk over the body.
Tie in spent yarn wings on each side.
Tie in an upright elk wing in front and finish.

new.name: George Nymph
new.description: An old nymph with a peacock body, a turkey and white yarn wing case and a brown hen throat.
new.fishing_tips: Drift it in mountain streams.
steps: Wrap a few turns of weight and tie in a brown hackle fibre tail.
Wrap a peacock herl body.
Tie in a turkey wing case over the rear and white yarn over the thorax.
Add a brown hen throat and finish.

new.name: Greg's Emerger
new.description: A small emerger with a clear midge bead, a pheasant tail tail, a ribbed superfine body and a pearl casing.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it below a dry.
steps: Slide on the clear midge bead and tie in a pheasant tail tail and copper wire.
Dub a slim superfine body and rib it.
Tie in a strip of pearl tinsel.
Pull the tinsel over the thorax and finish behind the bead.

new.name: Hardy's Favourite
new.description: A British wet fly with a tippet tail, a red-ribbed peacock body, a partridge hackle and a speckled hen wing.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it in a team of wets on lakes.
steps: Tie in a golden pheasant tippet tail and the red floss rib.
Wrap a peacock herl body.
Rib it with red floss and wind a partridge hackle.
Tie a speckled hen wing on top and finish.

new.name: Hipster Dufus
new.description: A carp fly with a lead lift kit, bead chain eyes, an orange and olive Laser Dub body, wood duck wings and a white CDC collar.
new.fishing_tips: Drop it in front of feeding carp.
steps: Lash two short sections of lead on top of the shank, then tie bead chain eyes in front.
Dub a fluorescent orange Laser Dub abdomen.
Tie a barred wood duck feather on each side as wings.
Dub an olive thorax, wind a white CDC collar and finish.

new.name: Hogan's S&M Nymph
new.description: A slim mayfly nymph with a copper bead, a thread body, an olive wire rib, a biot casing and Krystal Flash legs.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it as a dropper.
steps: Slide on the copper bead and tie in a short pheasant tail tail and the olive wire.
Build a slim, tapered thread body and rib it with the wire.
Tie in the goose biot for the casing and a few strands of Krystal Flash for legs, then dub the Antron thorax.
Pull the biot over the thorax, pull the legs back along the sides and finish behind the bead.

new.name: Iwan-E-Dun
new.description: A detached-body sulphur dun with mono tails, a post and a dun hackle.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it during sulphur hatches.
mats: 0.013 mono and pale yellow mayfly tails
steps: Build an extended body on a piece of mono with the mayfly tails at the end, coloured and coated with glue.
Tie the detached body on top of the hook at the thorax.
Tie in a poly yarn post and dub a sulphur thorax around it.
Wind a blue dun hackle parachute style around the post and finish.

new.name: Juju Emerger
new.description: A mayfly emerger with a Superhair body, hen legs and a CDC and fluoro fibre wing.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it in the film.
steps: Tie in split mayfly tails.
Twist black and olive Superhair together and wrap a segmented body.
Tie in a short CDC wing with a few strands of white fluorofibre, and hen fibres as legs.
Dub the thorax and a small head and finish.

new.name: Kamikaze Sculpin
new.description: A sculpin with pseudo eyes, a barred rabbit tail, a Simi Seal belly, a mallard collar and a rabbit dubbing head.
new.fishing_tips: Bounce it along the bottom.
mats: Rabbit fur in a dubbing loop
steps: Tie the pseudo eyes on top of the shank near the eye.
Tie in a barred rabbit strip tail with a few strands of Angel Hair, and dub a Simi Seal belly.
Wind a mallard flank collar.
Spin rabbit fur in a dubbing loop for a broad head, figure-eighting around the eyes, and trim flat underneath.

new.name: Little Black Soft Hackle
new.description: A soft hackle with a purple silk body, a magpie rib and a starling hackle.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it upstream in spring.
steps: Start the purple silk and tie in a magpie tail fibre as a rib.
Wrap a slim silk body.
Rib it with the magpie fibre.
Wind one or two turns of starling and finish a small head.

new.name: McPhail Caddis Pupa
new.description: A weighted caddis pupa with a yellow yarn body, scud back, seal's fur thorax, partridge legs, nylon eyes and mallard horns.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it deep in summer.
steps: Wrap a lead underbody on the grub hook.
Tie in the scud back and wrap a yellow yarn body around the bend, then pull the back over and rib it.
Dub a brown seal's fur thorax and add partridge legs.
Tie in burnt nylon eyes and bronze mallard horns, then pull the back over the thorax.

new.name: Meko Special
new.description: A bonefish fly with bead chain eyes, a pseudo hair tail and underbody, flash and a palmered brown hackle body.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it on the flats.
steps: Tie bead chain eyes on top of the shank near the eye.
Tie in a pseudo hair tail with a few strands of pearl flash.
Tie in a brown hackle and palmer it forward over a pseudo hair underbody.
Trim the hackle on top, glue the wraps and finish.

new.name: Mr. Jones Cranefly
new.description: A foam crane fly with moose hair wings and barred legs.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it in late summer.
steps: Tie in a thin strip of cinnamon foam and fold it to form a slim abdomen.
Tie in moose hair wings angled back on each side.
Tie in long barred legs along the sides.
Dub a cinnamon thorax, pull the foam over and colour with markers.

new.name: Mrs. Simpson
new.description: A New Zealand killer-style streamer with a squirrel tail, red chenille body and pheasant rump wings.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it at night for big trout.
steps: Tie in a black squirrel tail tail.
Wrap a red chenille body.
Tie pheasant rump feathers flat on each side in two or three pairs along the body.
Build a neat head and finish.

new.name: Muskrat Nymph
new.description: A muskrat nymph with a black hackle tail, a muskrat body, an ostrich thorax and black legs.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it in mountain streams.
steps: Tie in a tail of black hackle fibres with a few muskrat fibres on top.
Dub a tapered muskrat body.
Wrap a short black ostrich herl thorax.
Tie in black hackle fibres underneath as legs and finish.

new.name: Patriot
new.description: An attractor dry with a calf wing, a pearl flash body and brown hackle.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it in riffles.
steps: Tie in and divide a white calf body hair wing.
Tie in a brown hackle fibre tail.
Wrap a pearl flash body with a red thread band in the middle.
Wind a brown hackle behind and in front of the wing.

new.name: Pattegrisen Shrimp
new.description: A Danish sea trout shrimp with bucktail legs, a sand and sherbet dubbing body, coral rhea and a palmered hackle.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it slowly along coasts.
steps: Tie in red bucktail legs and rhea and peacock antennae at the bend.
Add the black shrimp eyes.
Dub a mixed sand and sherbet body and palmer a coral hackle through it.
Rib it with pink wire and trim the hackle on top.

new.name: Picket Pin
new.description: A peacock body wet fly with a palmered brown hackle and grey squirrel wing.
new.fishing_tips: Swing it for trout and panfish.
steps: Tie in a brown hackle fibre tail and the wire.
Wrap a peacock herl body and palmer a brown hackle through it.
Rib the body with wire.
Tie a grey squirrel tail wing on top and finish with a peacock head.

new.name: Puff Pastry
new.description: A bonefish puff variant with lead eyes, centipede legs, a deer belly mouth, a red Ice Dub head and a craft fur wing.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it on the flats.
steps: Tie lead eyes near the eye so the fly rides up.
Tie in a deer belly mouth and centipede legs at the bend.
Wrap a pearl Krystal Flash body.
Tie in a craft fur wing and dub a red Ice Dub head around the eyes.

new.name: Reverse Parachute Emerger
new.description: An emerger tied hook point up with a boar bristle tail, a resin-coated body, a dun hackle wing and CDC legs.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it to picky trout.
mats: Coq de Leon coloured with marker under UV
steps: Tie in a boar bristle tail with the hook point up.
Wrap a Coq de Leon abdomen, colour it with marker and coat with UV resin.
Tie in a light dun hackle as a reverse parachute under the hook.
Add CDC legs and finish.

new.name: Rogue Stone Salmonfly
new.description: A salmonfly dry with a foam body, a tape wing, moose overwing, a Big Bug Hair head and rubber legs.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it in the salmonfly hatch.
steps: Build a segmented orange foam body extending past the bend.
Tie in orange Krystal Flash and a tape wing cut to shape.
Add a moose body hair overwing.
Spin a Big Bug Hair head, add rubber legs and trim.

new.name: Simram
new.description: A bonefish shrimp with eyes, a polar fibre tail, a braid body and a rabbit collar.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it on the flats.
steps: Tie on the eyes near the eye.
Tie in a polar fibre tail with pearl flash.
Wrap a pearl braid body.
Wind a tan zonker strip as a collar and finish.

new.name: Skinny Nelson
new.description: A slim black midge nymph with a pheasant tail tail, a ribbed thread body, a peacock thorax and a pearl casing.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it as a dropper.
steps: Tie in a short pheasant tail tail and silver wire.
Build a slim black thread body and rib it.
Tie in the pearl tinsel and wrap a peacock herl thorax.
Pull the tinsel over the thorax and finish.

new.name: McPhail Small Baitfish
new.description: A small saltwater baitfish with hackle tail, green pearl body, opal sides, red gills and fur fabric back.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it for bass and small salt species.
mats: White Indian cock hackles and pearl flash
steps: Tie in a tail of white Indian cock hackles with pearl flash.
Wrap a green pearl Lite-Brite body with opal mirage tinsel along the sides.
Add red floss gills, a white bucktail throat and a faux fur wing on top.
Glue diamond eyes to the head and finish.

new.name: Small Mayfly Nymph
new.description: A realistic small mayfly nymph with a clear wrap body over copper, yellow partridge legs and a resin wing case.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it upstream.
mats: Clear wrap coloured with brown marker
steps: Tie in a Coq de Leon tail.
Wrap copper wire for weight, coat it with UV resin, then wrap clear wrap over it and colour the top with brown marker.
Tie in yellow partridge legs and dub a yellow thorax.
Coat the thorax cover with UV resin and colour it with brown pen.

new.name: Smitherman's Draggin' Nymph
new.description: A dragonfly nymph with bead chain eyes, a Laser Dub body, a SLF thorax, a hen collar and rubber legs.
new.fishing_tips: Crawl it along lake weeds.
steps: Tie on the bead chain eyes.
Dub a fat, tapered Laser Dub abdomen.
Dub an SLF thorax with rubber legs on each side.
Wind an olive grizzly hen collar and figure-eight dubbing around the eyes.

new.name: SF Baitfish
new.description: Steve Farrar's blend baitfish of white and olive SF fibres over an orange hackle belly with goo eyes.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it for stripers and snook.
steps: Tie in orange hackle fibres as a short belly.
Tie in white SF fibres, then olive fibres on top, in small bunches along the front of the shank.
Comb out and shape the fibres into a baitfish profile.
Glue on eyes and coat the head with UV finish.

new.name: Swimming Carp
new.description: A carp crayfish with rabbit tail and collar, a dubbed body, a sheeting casing and Crazy Legs.
new.fishing_tips: Twitch it near feeding carp.
steps: Wrap lead wire and tie in a rust rabbit tail.
Tie in the sheeting, dub a rust body and pull the sheeting over as a casing.
Tie in Crazy Legs on each side.
Wind a rust rabbit collar and finish.

new.name: Thief
new.description: A classic streamer with a red tail, a silver body, a squirrel underwing, a turkey overwing and a chenille head.
new.fishing_tips: Strip it for trout.
steps: Tie in a red duck slip tail and the rib.
Wind a silver mylar body and rib it with oval tinsel.
Tie in a squirrel tail underwing with brown turkey slips over it.
Wrap a black chenille head.

new.name: Timberline Emerger
new.description: Kaufmann's emerger with a marabou tail, a ribbed grey body, grizzly hen tip wings and a brown hackle.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it near the surface in lakes.
steps: Tie in a short grey marabou tail and copper wire.
Dub a grey fur body and rib it.
Tie grizzly hen tips flat on top as short wings.
Wind a brown hen hackle and finish.

new.name: Triangle Bug
new.description: A foam panfish bug with a calf tail and buggy legs.
new.fishing_tips: Twitch it for bluegill.
mats: Tan 2 mm foam, cut in a triangle
steps: Tie in a tan calf tail tail.
Cut a triangle of tan foam.
Glue and tie the foam down on the shank with the point forward.
Tie in buggy legs at the tie-down point.

new.name: Trico Dun
new.description: A tiny trico dun with a white tail, an olive quill body, white hen wings and a black hackle.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it on summer mornings.
steps: Tie in white hen neck feather wings and divide them.
Tie in a white Coq de Leon tail.
Wrap an olive stripped quill body.
Wind a black hackle and finish.

new.name: Tungsten Swing Caddis
new.description: A caddis pupa with a tungsten bead, a midge tubing body, a CDC collar, an Ice Dub thorax and partridge.
new.fishing_tips: Swing it at the end of the drift.
steps: Slide on the tungsten bead and start white thread.
Wrap an olive midge tubing body.
Wind a CDC collar and dub a pheasant tail Ice Dub thorax.
Wind a partridge collar behind the bead and finish in black.

new.name: Vanilla Bugger
new.description: A cream conehead bugger with a marabou tail, a furry foam body and a cream hackle.
new.fishing_tips: Strip it for trout and bass.
steps: Slide on the cone and tie in a marabou tail with pearl flash.
Tie in the hackle and a strip of cream furry foam.
Wrap the furry foam body forward.
Palmer the hackle through the body and finish behind the cone.

new.name: Wally Wing Mayfly
new.description: A mayfly with a moose mane tail, a ribbed Hendrickson body and a mallard flank wing.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it to Hendrickson risers.
steps: Tie in a moose mane tail.
Dub a Hendrickson body and rib it with black thread.
Fold a mallard flank feather into a Wally wing and stand it upright.
Wind a barred ginger hackle around the wing.

new.name: Zirdle Bug
new.description: A girdle bug with an orange bead, a variegated chenille body, superfloss legs and a rabbit wing.
new.fishing_tips: Dead-drift it deep.
steps: Slide on the orange tungsten bead.
Tie in the chenille and superfloss legs at the bend.
Wrap the body, tying in legs on each side as you go.
Tie a rabbit strip wing on top and finish behind the bead.
